Lane2 Beta appears in What changed after a Beta search. The unfiltered panel selects Gamma and Rookie. Beta Power falls from 1950 to 1901, delta -49, while rank stays 2 to 2. This means lower Power, not lost places.
Lane2 series deltas sum to -42 while the endpoint delta is -49. This remains an unresolved R4 observation. It is not a cleared defect or a silently accepted difference.
Normal and exact Lane2 Beta numbers are equal. Other receipts establish scope. Six objects were warm in the browser cache. No cache, request-count, ABAB, or performance credit follows.
Lane5 has 138 buffered resource entries out of 139 from before observer installation. Window errors before installation are not covered. Lane2 retains the same pre-install error coverage limit.
Reviewer document time for Lane2 and Lane5 says 21:35Z. Root uses actual receipt times and its 21:29:10Z countersign. No admission timing follows from the document field.
